title: Defined Terms: Short Documents and the Acceptance of a Paper Temporary License
content:
These defined terms of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product decide how a Wayfare driver's other documents on file bear on the temporary license acceptance days: the calendar days from the upload day for which a paper temporary driver's license is accepted as the driver's license on file.

### "Documents counted"

The auto insurance and the vehicle inspection, plus the for-hire permit on the Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV levels, each by its expiry date on the agreement. On the Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL levels the for-hire permit is not counted.

### "Short document"

Each document counted whose expiry date on the agreement lies fewer than 30 calendar days after the upload day, or is already past, is a short document. A document whose expiry date lies 30 days or more after the upload day is not short.

### Rule

With two or more short documents the temporary license acceptance days change by -12 days; with exactly one they change by -6 days; with none they do not change.

| Short documents | Change to the temporary license acceptance days |
|---|---|
| two or more | -12 |
| exactly one | -6 |
| none | 0 |

### Worked readings (hypothetical, upload day 2026-08-10)

- Wayfare XL. Auto insurance expires 2026-09-08 (29 days after: short); inspection expires 2026-09-09 (30 days after: not short). One short document: -6.
- Wayfare Black. Auto insurance expires 2027-01-01 (not short); inspection expired 2026-08-01 (already past: short); for-hire permit expires 2026-08-20 (10 days after: short). Two short documents: -12.
- Wayfare Green. Auto insurance and inspection both expire in 2027. No short document: no change.
